# Mirror of the root `requirements-vercel.txt` — DO NOT edit independently.
#
# This exact copy exists because Vercel's Python builder (@vercel/python)
# resolves the `requirements.txt` nearest to the entrypoint file declared
# in `vercel.json` (`qknee/api/server.py`) before falling back to one at
# the project root. The project root's `requirements.txt` is the full
# Render/Docker ML stack (torch, torchvision, pennylane, SimpleITK,
# nibabel, ...) and must stay that way for those targets — so this
# colocated file is what actually keeps the Vercel function bundle under
# the 500MB serverless function size limit. See `requirements-vercel.txt`
# at the repo root for the full rationale; keep the two files identical.

fastapi>=0.110.0
